package.name: aav_navigator
package.description: Our own navigator in Rust (rclrs): what Nav2's bt_navigator, our behaviour trees and waypoint_follower do for the car (plan, follow, replan, keep the path on the final approach, recover: clear costmaps, wait, back up, give up; through-poses; waypoints and GPS waypoints through navsat_transform's datum). A trial beside Nav2's (navigation.launch.py navigator:=own): it serves NavigateToPose, NavigateThroughPoses, FollowWaypoints and FollowGPSWaypoints under /drivers/nav/navigator/.
